long_biography.plain_text:
Liquid Web began after Matthew J. Hill turned the problems of running a popular software site into a hosting opportunity. At sixteen, he launched a shared-hosting company in Holt, Michigan, then reinvested in customer service and technical infrastructure. Growing demand led to company-operated data centres, giving the business closer control over reliability and support.

Hill remained founder and chief executive as Liquid Web expanded into dedicated servers, virtual private servers and cloud infrastructure. By 2015, the company served more than 30,000 clients across 150 countries. A private-equity investment that year accompanied his departure from the chief executive role, closing an eighteen-year founder-led chapter. He died in 2022 at 41.

uncertainties.detail: Matthew Hill is a common name. Resolution does not rely on the name alone: the owner-context bridge, immutable American identity and age data, existing social lead, Liquid Web founder role and Holt/Lansing geography converge on the same person. The K2 Alliance marketer, business anthropologist, lawyers, academics, athletes and other namesakes were rejected.

The immutable record gives the display name Matthew J. Hill, while strong company and news sources use Matthew Hill or Matt Hill. A lower-quality obituary index suggests a possible expansion, but it is not sufficiently authoritative; the dossier retains the initial without proposing an expanded name.

The immutable record gives birth year 1981, but published age-at-death evidence and lower-tier obituary indexes indicate that 1980 may be correct. No strong source reviewed supplied a complete birth date, so the existing birth year is not proposed for correction and birth day and month remain unfilled.

Hill sold Liquid Web and left its chief executive role in 2015. Public references to later entertainment activity do not establish a dominant personal wealth-producing sector with sufficient source strength, so the primary industry remains Unknown.

The 2015 investment and sale are established, but the consideration and Hill's personal proceeds were not publicly disclosed in the strong sources reviewed. The dossier therefore does not assign a transaction or net-worth figure to him.

The immutable record already contains LinkedIn and Instagram URLs, so they are not re-proposed. Their public pages were inaccessible to automated verification, and no missing personal website or other personal profile cleared the confidence threshold. Liquid Web's official website is proposed because its founder connection is direct and independently corroborated.

Asset facts were used only for identity resolution and are excluded from both biographies. Cause-of-death detail, private-family information, politics, allegations, legal matters, controversy, transient company figures and speculative later investments are also excluded.
